targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Clusters" FROM inventory.k8s_clusters c JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=c.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${cluster:sqlstring}='All' OR c.cluster_key=${cluster:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) AS "Nodes" FROM inventory.k8s_nodes n JOIN inventory.k8s_clusters c ON c.id=n.cluster_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=c.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${cluster:sqlstring}='All' OR c.cluster_key=${cluster:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) AS "Namespaces" FROM inventory.k8s_namespaces ns JOIN inventory.k8s_clusters c ON c.id=ns.cluster_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=c.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${cluster:sqlstring}='All' OR c.cluster_key=${cluster:sqlstring}) AND (${namespace:sqlstring}='All' OR ns.name=${namespace:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) AS "Workloads" FROM inventory.k8s_workloads w JOIN inventory.k8s_namespaces ns ON ns.id=w.namespace_id JOIN inventory.k8s_clusters c ON c.id=ns.cluster_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=c.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${cluster:sqlstring}='All' OR c.cluster_key=${cluster:sqlstring}) AND (${namespace:sqlstring}='All' OR ns.name=${namespace:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) AS "Pods" FROM inventory.k8s_pods p JOIN inventory.k8s_namespaces ns ON ns.id=p.namespace_id JOIN inventory.k8s_clusters c ON c.id=ns.cluster_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=c.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${cluster:sqlstring}='All' OR c.cluster_key=${cluster:sqlstring}) AND (${namespace:sqlstring}='All' OR ns.name=${namespace:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.phase<>'Running') AS "Unhealthy Pods" FROM inventory.k8s_pods p JOIN inventory.k8s_namespaces ns ON ns.id=p.namespace_id JOIN inventory.k8s_clusters c ON c.id=ns.cluster_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=c.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${cluster:sqlstring}='All' OR c.cluster_key=${cluster:sqlstring}) AND (${namespace:sqlstring}='All' OR ns.name=${namespace:sqlstring})

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center",c.name AS "Cluster",c.distribution AS "Distribution",c.version AS "Version",initcap(c.status) AS "Status",count(DISTINCT n.id) AS "Nodes",count(DISTINCT ns.id) AS "Namespaces",count(DISTINCT w.id) AS "Workloads",count(DISTINCT p.id) AS "Pods",count(DISTINCT p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.phase<>'Running') AS "Unhealthy Pods",o.name AS "Owner",c.last_seen_at AS "Last Seen",CASE WHEN c.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.k8s_clusters c JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=c.site_id LEFT JOIN inventory.owners o ON o.id=c.owner_id LEFT JOIN inventory.k8s_nodes n ON n.cluster_id=c.id LEFT JOIN inventory.k8s_namespaces ns ON ns.cluster_id=c.id LEFT JOIN inventory.k8s_workloads w ON w.namespace_id=ns.id LEFT JOIN inventory.k8s_pods p ON p.namespace_id=ns.id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${cluster:sqlstring}='All' OR c.cluster_key=${cluster:sqlstring}) GROUP BY c.id,s.name,o.name ORDER BY s.name,c.name

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center",c.name AS "Cluster",ns.name AS "Namespace",w.workload_type AS "Kind",w.name AS "Workload",w.desired_replicas AS "Desired",w.available_replicas AS "Available",p.name AS "Pod",p.phase AS "Phase",n.name AS "Node",p.pod_ip::text AS "Pod IP",p.qos_class AS "QoS",ct.name AS "Container",ct.image AS "Image",ct.status AS "Container Status",p.last_seen_at AS "Last Seen",CASE WHEN p.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.k8s_pods p JOIN inventory.k8s_namespaces ns ON ns.id=p.namespace_id JOIN inventory.k8s_clusters c ON c.id=ns.cluster_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=c.site_id LEFT JOIN inventory.k8s_workloads w ON w.id=p.workload_id LEFT JOIN inventory.k8s_nodes n ON n.id=p.node_id LEFT JOIN inventory.k8s_containers ct ON ct.pod_id=p.id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${cluster:sqlstring}='All' OR c.cluster_key=${cluster:sqlstring}) AND (${namespace:sqlstring}='All' OR ns.name=${namespace:sqlstring}) ORDER BY CASE p.phase WHEN 'Failed' THEN 1 WHEN 'Pending' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,s.name,c.name,ns.name,p.name

list.label: Data Center
list.name: site
list.query: SELECT site_key AS __value,name AS __text FROM inventory.sites ORDER BY name

list.label: Cluster
list.name: cluster
list.query: SELECT c.cluster_key AS __value,c.name AS __text FROM inventory.k8s_clusters c JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=c.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) ORDER BY c.name

list.label: Namespace
list.name: namespace
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ns.name AS __value,ns.name AS __text FROM inventory.k8s_namespaces ns JOIN inventory.k8s_clusters c ON c.id=ns.cluster_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=c.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${cluster:sqlstring}='All' OR c.cluster_key=${cluster:sqlstring}) ORDER BY ns.name
